description: Hello #TeamCastro! First, I want to thank everyone for their contributions last week as we hit a critical fundraising deadline. Your support continues to fuel this campaign as we fight hard to bring the people of District 37 the transparent, accessible, inclusive leadership they deserve. AND YOU HEARD IT HERE FIRST! I have been endorsed by Stacey Abrams! Stacey is not only our Democratic nominee for the Governor's race in 2018 and 2022, she is the former Minority Leader of the Georgia House of Representatives, an attorney and national voting rights advocate. I am both honored and humbled by this endorsement. I have met so many incredible public servants on this journey, but meeting with Leader Abrams was truly inspirational. I count her among the change-makers that I admire, and aspire to serve the people of Georgia with the same tenacity and drive. Darcy Castro Candidate for Georgia Senate District 37
title: News from Darcy Castro
